name: Csönge (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, yellow at the hoist and blue at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csönge (a white shield with a crown, crossed sabres and a wavy stripe) above the name CSÖNGE in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
